mbpp.title: Mostly Basic Python Problems, hand-verified subset
mbpp.authors: Jacob Austin and colleagues, Google Research (2021)
mbpp.changes: Prompt and test examples inserted into the Supra instruction format; solutions are not used. Original MBPP split ranges are retained.

dolly.title: databricks-dolly-15k, pinned April 2023 snapshot
dolly.source_id: dolly:<zero-based line in the pinned snapshot>
dolly.changes: Instruction and context inserted into the Supra instruction format; responses are not used. Selected Dolly prompt adaptations remain under CC-BY-SA-3.0.

generated.title: DART verification workload generator
generated.changes: New split-separated dialogue, shell transcript, INI stanza and HTML badge templates.

protocol.selection: Input-only SHA-256 ordering with seed 307; no candidate outputs or timings used. MBPP split ranges and Dolly family split assignment from the earlier protocol are retained.
protocol.composition: Per workload: 2 train, 4 validation and 12 test records. Code uses MBPP; instruction and structured alternate their two Dolly categories; repetition uses new generated template families.
protocol.deduplication: No source or family shared with the earlier v0.3 corpus; unique real source families; no shared sources or families across new splits. Reject identical normalized text and word-four-gram Jaccard >= 0.5 against earlier inputs and across new splits. Lexical checks do not prove semantic independence; within-split generated families can repeat.
protocol.lengths: Indices 0 and 6 in each non-code workload have 384-896 prompt tokens; other cases have 1-383. Code cases are short. Reserve seven lookahead positions within context 1024.
protocol.budgets: Within each workload cycle 16, 32, 64 tokens. Natural EOS may finish early.
protocol.timing_selection: First three test cases per workload, chosen before outputs: 12 cases, four workloads and all three output budgets. Timing repetitions and configurations are frozen separately after development pilots.
protocol.train_purpose: Execution diagnosis only; no model training.
protocol.limits: Small decoding benchmark, not answer quality or a representative production sample. Held out from DART tuning, not guaranteed absent from Supra pretraining. Prior v0.3 corpus remains historical evidence.
